==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|sāl}}, {{IPA|en|/seːl/|}}
* {{IPA|en|/seɪl/|a=pane-pain}}, {{rhymes|en|eɪl|s=1}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-sale.ogg|a=US}}
* {{homophones|en|sail<aa:pane-pain>|;|sell|cell<aa:fell-fail merger>}}

===Etymology 1===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*selh₁-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|sale}}, from {{inh|en|ang|sala||act of selling, sale}}, from {{der|en|non|sala||sale}}, from {{der|en|gem-pro|*salō||delivery}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*selh₁-||to grab}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun|~}}

# An [[exchange]] of goods or services for currency or credit.
#: {{ux|en|He celebrated after the '''sale''' of company.}}
# {{senseid|en|discount sale}} {{ellipsis of|en|discount sale|t=the sale of goods at reduced prices}}.
#: {{ux|en|They are having a clearance '''sale''': 50% off.}}
# The act of putting up for auction to the highest bidder.

=====Troponyms=====
* {{sense|selling of goods at reduced prices}} [[cut-rate sale]], [[sales event]]
* {{sense|act of putting up for auction to the highest bidder}} [[auction]], [[public sale]]

===Etymology 2===
From {{inh|en|enm|sale}}, {{m|enm|sal}}, from {{inh|en|ang|sæl||room, hall, castle}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*salą||house, hall}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*sel-||home, dwelling, village}}. Cognate with {{cog|fy|seal}}, {{cog|nl|zaal}}, {{cog|de|Saal}}, {{cog|sv|sal}}, {{cog|is|salur}}, {{cog|lt|sala||village}}. {{doublet|en|sala|salle}}. Related also to {{m|en|salon}}, {{m|en|saloon}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|obsolete}} A [[hall]].
